Jared (Revenue Ops): FYI vendor rebate invoices from CloudRack arrived late and hit AP on 3/28. Close is 3/31. Should we accrue the vendor rebate reduction to Hosted revenue or treat as an out-of-period adjustment? Need recommendation for auditors.

Priya (Billing): AP ticket #AP-3421 shows vendor credit memos totaling $22,450. They reference usage period Feb 2026 but were submitted late. Invoices include partner promo pass-through lines.

Hannah (RevRec): If the vendor rebate reduces consideration for delivered services in Feb, GAAP prefers accrual in period of performance (Feb). We should record contra-revenue accrual and corresponding payable to vendor. But need evidence vendor is obligated and amount is estimable.

Jared (Revenue Ops): We have contractual rebate schedule in the reseller MSA (section 4.2) that defines a calculated quarterly rebate. Vendor confirms the amounts in email chain (attached to AP ticket).

Maya (Controller): Draft JE proposal: Dr Hosted revenue rebates (4015) $22,450; Cr Accrued vendor credits (2600) $22,450. Please prepare working paper: contract excerpt, vendor email confirmation, and AP copy. If evidence is weak, we'll do a post-close adjustment instead.

Priya (Billing): I pulled the AP extract: select id, vendor, gross_amount, memo, created_at from vendor_credits where created_at between '2026-02-01' and '2026-03-28' and source='CloudRack'; Uploaded /shared/finance/ap_cloudrack_credits_2026-03.csv.

Hannah (RevRec): I'll draft accrual memo referencing MSA clause and show calculation (line-by-line). If Maya approves, post accrual tag CLOSE-ACCRUAL-2026-03-VENDR. Otherwise mark as adjustment in April.

billing-bot: Reminder: close checklist item 'vendor accruals review' due in 48h. https://redwood.internal/close/2026-03/vendor-accruals

Maya (Controller): Good plan. Proceed to draft JE and upload supporting docs. I'll review and sign once the working paper is in the close folder.

Jared (Revenue Ops): Will upload memo and request sign-off by EOD. Thanks team.
